payload.reason: The evidence indicates that LSTM and GRU with Attention models outperform other methods in offensive language identification tasks, particularly in terms of macro-F1, precision, and recall for both Offensive and Not Offensive classes.

claims.text: LSTM and GRU with Attention outperformed all other models in offensive language identification tasks.
Linear SVM and SGDC are effective but do not surpass the performance of LSTM and GRU with Attention.
Fine-tuning BERT-Base Multilingual Cased model did not yield good results for this task.
